name: Jouryuu Tsuma ~Celeb Oyako ni Fukushuu WakaraSEX~
original_name: 上流妻 ～セレブ母娘に復讐わからSEX～
source:
Sakachi Tomooki thought he’d finally scored his ideal life after landing a job at a major corporation through a friend’s connections. But when he visited the president’s office to greet the higher-ups, the president’s wife, Takamiya Maho, suddenly declared he “looked too low-class for the company” and fired him on the spot. To twist the knife, she framed him for pushing her down and had him arrested as a rapist. Crushed to the lowest point of his life, Tomooki swore revenge on the Takamiya family...!!

[Translated from [url=https://www.bugbug.news/b_game/146680/]BugBug[/url]]
